# Graphics/Helpers

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [DisplayLink.h](DisplayLink.h): Timing for one DisplayLink frame: `time` is seconds since the link started, `delta` is seconds since the previous frame (0 on the first frame, clamped to 0.1s across stalls so animations step rather than jump). (declares `FrameTime`, `DisplayLink`)
- [FramePacer.h](FramePacer.h): The divider behind a frame-rate cap: fed the time between ticks of a clock that runs faster than wanted, it says which ticks to act on so they come at most `fps` times a second. (declares `FramePacer`)
- [SystemAppearance.h](SystemAppearance.h): True when the OS is currently using a dark interface theme. (declares `isSystemDarkMode`)

<!-- agent-docs:end -->
